about: News Package house look (fixed; one house look per style, new components every reel). Ported from the MIT-licensed lemo-opuscar style 'Broadcast News Package' (styles/news-package/STYLE.md, https://github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar) and adapted from a 16:9 bulletin with no anchor to a 9:16 talking head: the speaker is the anchor, the package frames them and the full-frame graphics cut between face shots.
world: a one-story news segment: a sting that becomes the channel bug, the speaker's face as shot with the lower-third strap on their chest, a rundown of the reel's points that opens and comes back ticked off, and full-frame package cards on ink (document, split-flap board, check rows, accent-edged cards, a schematic threshold line, proportion bars) that carry one fact each
layout: 1080x1920 at 30 fps. Safe area: nothing above y 120, nothing right of x 980, nothing below y 1700. Bug top right, plate centre (825, 185), right edge <= 980. Corner tag top left at (60, 140), 80 high. Card content y 260-1290 (above the strap). Strap: tab y 1322 (68 high), paper body y 1390 (170 high), x 60-860, ink end block x 860-980; headline baseline 1468 (1490 when there is no sub-line), sub-line baseline 1530; source line right-aligned at x 980 on an ink box, baseline 1630. On the face the strap sits on the chest (the chin was above y ~1250 on every plate of the proof; check yours), never on the face; nothing is ever drawn between y 400 and 1250 in the x 250-830 face box while a face plate shows.

type.rule: all on-screen words >= 48 px (the house floor); every string is checked against the font's cmap at build time
type.roles: s8 (Fira Sans 800) = the source's Noto Sans SC 900: strap headlines and card titles; c8 (Fira Sans Extra Condensed 800) = Barlow Condensed 800: the plate, numbers, tabs, row titles, card words, stamps; c6 = Barlow Condensed 600: strap sub-lines (caps, dark olive on paper); c6i = Barlow 600 italic (reserved for an end card); mono (IBM Plex Mono 500) = Plex Mono: eyebrows, source lines, corner tags, timecodes, caps with 2-3 px tracking
type.substitutions: Barlow Condensed has no Cyrillic -> Fira Sans Extra Condensed (OFL, Cyrillic, 600/800/600i); Noto Sans SC 900 -> Fira Sans 800 (OFL, Cyrillic); IBM Plex Mono 500 kept (OFL, has Cyrillic). woff2 subsets from Google Fonts in recipes/news-package/fonts with their OFL files; IBM Plex Mono has the Reserved Font Name 'Plex', so it ships as the unmodified TTF (fonts/ttf) instead of a subset; the builder copies them into assets/fonts.

palette.note: one accent (lemon) + one gold secondary + paper + ink, and a reserved alarm colour (breaking orange, only for a real BREAKING / LIVE; a tips reel never uses it). Ink text on lemon; on paper the secondary line is dark olive, never gold.

package.plate: parallelogram 520x180 (scaled), lemonL->lemonD vertical gradient, an ink bar and a gold bar at the left (slant k = 0.28 h), the channel word in c8 at 0.8 h, ink; the same object is the sting, the bug and the end card
package.channel_word: ON AIR (a neutral broadcast word in the reel's language, not a channel name; never the source's LEMO / AI NEWS)
package.strap: paper body with a 14 px lemon bar at the left, an 8 px drop shadow, an ink end block with a 6 px lemon top edge carrying the channel word; the tab above in lemon with ink caps (category, numbered for a story: '01 · NOTIFICATIONS'); headline s8 60 px ink (fit to 736 px, never under 48, never wraps), sub-line c6 48 px caps olive
package.flip: new words up from below, old up and out, 0.32 s inside the strap's clip; the tab flashes white for 3 frames when the category changes
package.card: full-frame ink with the studio background (radial lemon glow at upper right, dot grid, slow diagonal light bands) and an accent-edged ink card grammar: ink2 cards with a 6 px lemon top edge
package.stamp: ink fill with a double lemon frame, rotated -8 deg, c8 caps (lemon + paper), lands from x1.9 in 0.16 s with an expanding ellipse; one per story at most
package.corner_tag: ink box (82 %) with an 8 px gold bar, mono caps gold: SCHEMATIC on every schematic graphic (no data behind it), for as long as it is on screen
package.band_wipe: vertical band (lemon 84 px + ink 5 px + gold 14 px) crossing left to right in 0.3 s, power2.inOut; the new picture is revealed left of the band and its entry animation already runs underneath

motion.rule: only three transitions: the band wipe between programme parts and stories, a hard cut (with a low impact) inside a story, nothing else (no dissolves, flips of the frame, page turns); a package action every 0.5-1 s inside a card; the speaker's face is never moved, scaled or filtered
motion.sting: slashes 0.00 / 0.04 s, plate slam x1.35 -> 1 back.out(2.2) 0-0.22 s with a 2.5 deg rotation settle, letters drop one by one 0.06 s apart, impact ring 0.16-0.55 s, wordmark opens from the centre 0.26-0.46 s, glint 0.45-0.68 s, wordmark out 0.62 s, plate flies to the bug 0.72-1.02 s while the band wipes into the face
motion.rows: rundown rows flip in vertically (scaleY 0.02 -> 1, back.out(2)) 0.2-0.25 s apart with a light sweep; the recap ticks each row (lemon disc + ink check, back.out(2.6)) on the speaker's words
motion.push_up: titles and card words push up from a mask (nested svg viewport), 0.32 s power3.out
motion.flap: split-flap tiles: top half folds down 0.08 s, bottom half unfolds 0.08 s, tiles 0.05 s apart
motion.threshold: the line head advances one step per word, a held beat before the last step, the crossing in lemon with a 0.3 s shake and a ring
motion.stamp: x1.9 -> 1 in 0.16 s, opacity in 0.05 s, ring 0.05-0.5 s

sound.rule: the voice + SFX only (no music bed, no score, no musical stingers); a sound only where something enters: a hit on the sting slam, a whoosh on every band wipe, a low impact on hard cuts inside a story (the source's timpani), pops as rundown rows land (the source's glockenspiel), ticks on split-flaps and line steps, a stamp thump, the heaviest hit (deep boom) on the threshold crossing after a held beat, clicks on checkbox ticks and recap ticks, one bell on the last tick
sound.density: about 12 per 10 s, all short and well under the voice (whoosh 0.28-0.32, ticks 0.2-0.3, impacts 0.35-0.5, boom 0.55)
sound.missing: the source's orchestral news theme, timpani and glockenspiel are music and are not used; stand-ins: impact-2 for timpani, pop-1/pop-3 for glockenspiel notes, ding-1 once on the last recap tick

budgets.face: the speaker's face as shot 35-45 % of the reel, in 1-3 windows plus short ones between cards
budgets.graphics: one fact per card; a card holds until every item has been fully on screen >= 1.5 s (the source: 2.5 s at 16:9 news pace)
budgets.pictures: graphics drawn in code; at most one real picture per story (the book cover the speaker names), never generated plates; no people pictures
budgets.facts: nothing on screen beyond what the speaker says and the source they name; schematic charts carry SCHEMATIC and no numbers

film: the speaker's face as shot: no grade, no filter, no tint, no graphic over the face
grade_rule: none: the face plates stay as shot; the source's duotone plate grade is not used (no plates)
vary_per_reel: the story structure (round-up of 3-5 points, one lead package, a countdown)
which full-frame graphic each point gets (document, split-flap, check rows, accent cards, threshold line, proportion bars, quote card, map) and its timing
the strap words and categories, the sting wordmark line
the transitions' placement (band wipes between parts, hard cuts inside a part)
components_rule: the house is the package system (plate, bug, strap, tab, rundown, band wipe, stamp, corner tag, palette, type); the full-frame graphics are NEW every reel (components.py plan / check / record, catalog.json)
